editorial:
Ever felt like you and your partner are just speaking two different languages? You will definitely relate to that feeling here. The story follows a couple who just cannot seem to stay away from each other, even though they fight constantly. They spend a good chunk of the movie trying to make a set of rules for their relationship to see if they can actually make things work. It feels like a long, funny conversation between two people who love each other but are totally exhausted by their own drama. The vibe is light and breezy, making it the perfect choice for a lazy Sunday afternoon.

The acting feels very real, which helps you root for them even when they are being stubborn. While the plot is simple and doesn't have huge shocks, the chemistry between the leads keeps you interested. If you like movies that focus on talking and feelings rather than big action scenes, you will love this. It is a great pick for a date night or a solo watch. You can easily find this for renting on Apple TV or streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video if you want the best picture quality.
endingExplained: After all the arguing and the failed attempts to follow their strict rules, the couple finally realizes that love is not about a perfect plan. They stop trying to control every little detail of their relationship and decide to just be honest with each other. They choose to stay together by accepting their flaws. It ends on a sweet, hopeful note where they decide to take things slow and trust their feelings over a list of rules.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute rom-coms about messy couples.
